definitions.gloss: to frequent, to hang out at, to be a regular at
definitions.explanation: To spend a lot of time at a particular place, visiting so often that one practically lives there.

examples.japanese: ⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|い}り{浸|びた}る。
examples.english: To hang out at a cafe all the time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦ゲームセンター→ゲームセンター：27104_geemusentaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|い}り{浸|びた}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He hangs out at the arcade every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|い}り{浸|びた}って、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいた→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: When I was a student, I practically lived in the library, reading books from morning to night.

notes:
CONJUGATION (godan-ru):
- Negative: {入|い}り{浸|びた}らない
- Te-form: {入|い}り{浸|びた}って
- Past: {入|い}り{浸|びた}った

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. Takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ for the place being frequented.

ASPECT (ている):
{入|い}り{浸|びた}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ is the most common form, describing the ongoing state of always being at a place.

USAGE:
Often carries a slightly negative or humorous nuance, suggesting someone spends more time at a place than is productive or expected. Can be used self-deprecatingly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|い}り{浸|びた}る: to hang out at a cafe constantly
- ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|い}り{浸|びた}る: to be always at a friend's house
- ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|い}り{浸|びた}る: to practically live in the library
